Simple Formula:  Iniciate a term plan for 60 years ( Family Secured in your absence ). Now 
1. Land 2. Own House on it.3.Plant Trees around the land
4. Accumulate at least 5Lk as emergency fund. ( Medical purpose )
5. Recurring for 10 K / month ( for yearly tour)
6. SIP of 10K in at least three diversified fund for longer period 
7.Gold( for your daughter or daughter in law)
8. Bond
9. Fixed
 
10. Next steps of following as per sequence :
 Business, msme, small scale, pvt. Ltd. Industry 
10. Charity.
Retirement @60 (stop term insurance ).
Enjoy rest of life.
